name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast by default for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users can see focus clearly without strain, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for contrast while balancing visibility and subtlety. The trade-off is slightly reduced visibility for users with low vision, but 7:1 remains robust for most, and we can override it later if needed.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—focus ring disappears when motion is off, leaving no visible focus for keyboard users. Better alternative: use a 3px ring at 4.5:1, which survives both modes and still meets AA. Settle it by testing with screen readers and motion-sensitive users.
